fields.Symptoms: Expanding area of redness at the site of a tick bite, fever, headache, tiredness [ 1 ]
fields.Complications: Facial nerve paralysis, arthritis, meningitis-like symptoms, [ 2 ] heart rhythm irregularities [ 3 ]
fields.Diagnostic method: Based on symptoms, tick exposure, blood tests [ 5 ]
fields.Prevention: Prevention of tick bites (clothing the limbs, DEET ), doxycycline [ 4 ]
fields.Frequency: ~476k/year in U.S. (a likely overestimate), 200k/year in Europe [ 6 ] [ 7 ] [ 8 ]
